description: House commands become existing light overrides; profile commands update existing baseline stores. Brightness adjusts an active effect intensity; explicit colour returns to ordinary control.

sequence.value_template: {{ attribute != 'effect' or value in ['Normal light'] + catalog.effects.keys()|list }}

default.data: {{ {'brightness':value|int} if attribute == 'brightness' else {'rgb_color':(value.split(',') if value is string else value)|map('int')|list} if attribute == 'rgb' else {'color_temp_kelvin':(1000000/(value|float))|round|int} if attribute == 'temperature' else {} }}

variables.records: {% set n=namespace(r=[]) %}{% set active=state_attr('sensor.effects_controller','assignments') or {} %}{% set overrides=state_attr('sensor.ls_overrides','overrides') or {} %}{% for L in targets %}{% set record=overrides.get('light:' ~ L) %}{% set prior=record.get('value') if record is mapping else none %}{% set prior=prior if prior is mapping else {} %}{% set previous_effect=prior.get('effect','Normal light') if record is mapping else active.get(L,{}).get('effect','Normal light') %}{% set ef=value if attribute=='effect' else previous_effect if attribute=='brightness' else 'Normal light' %}{% set b=value|int if attribute=='brightness' else prior.get('brightness',active.get(L,{}).get('brightness',state_attr(L,'brightness')|int(150))) %}{% set val={'effect':ef,'brightness':b,'token':stamp} if attribute=='effect' or (attribute=='brightness' and ef!='Normal light') else {'brightness':b} if attribute=='brightness' else none %}{% set n.r=n.r+[{'kind':'light','target':L,'value':val}] %}{% endfor %}{{ n.r }}

default.wait_template: {% set ns=namespace(ok=true) %}{% for r in records %}{% set stored=(state_attr('sensor.ls_overrides','overrides') or {}).get('light:' ~ r.target,{}) %}{% if stored.get('value') != r.value or as_timestamp(stored.get('when'),0) < stamp|float %}{% set ns.ok=false %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.ok }}

variables.normal_targets: {% set n=namespace(ids=[]) %}{% for r in records if r.value is not mapping or 'effect' not in r.value %}{% set n.ids=n.ids+[r.target] %}{% endfor %}{{ n.ids }}

then.data: {{ {'brightness':value|int} if attribute=='brightness' else {'rgb_color':(value.split(',') if value is string else value)|map('int')|list} if attribute=='rgb' else {'color_temp_kelvin':(1000000/(value|float))|round|int} }}
